[[File:Lord_of_War_AoD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A CLL-8 binary load lifter at work]]
The '''CLL-series''' was a series of [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|Binary loadlifter]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. They were designed as low intelligence [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] that had as a primary function, the lifting of heavy objects.
